We’re closing out this week’s Green Deals led by the Bluetti Encore Sale that is completely switching up its power station deals, including bringing back the winter-ready 900Wh Pioneer Na(Sodium) Portable Power Station at an exclusive $665 low . Right behind that, we have three exclusive deals on Anker solar multi-cam kits with HomeBase 3 that end tonight, starting from $290 . There’s also the Navee Fall EV Sale that is offering a nice array of bonus extra savings (up to 65% off total) on e-scooters, like the premium UT5 Ultra X Electric SuperScooter down at a new $1,600 low at $900 off. You’ll also find lows for an EGO carbon fiber string trimmer kit, a compact Greenworks chainsaw, a Linkind Matter outdoor smart plug, and more. Don’t forget, we also have all the lasting Prime Day deals collected in our Fall Prime Day Green Deals hub here , as well as the hangover deals from yesterday at the bottom of the page, including the Anker SOLIX Encore Sale , the extended Segway electric scooter deals , EcoFlow’s latest flash sale lineup , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Bluetti’s Encore Sale brings back winter-ready Pioneer Na(Sodium) power station at exclusive new $665 low, more from $499
Bluetti has launched a Fall Prime Deals Encore Sale that is not only offering extended savings, but has also largely shifted the lineup with new inclusions and offers. One such new addition is the winter-ready 900Wh Pioneer Na(Sodium) Portable Power Station down at $665 shipped , after using the code 9TO5TOYS5OFF at checkout. This model hit the scene back in October 2025 with a $999 full price, which we previously saw discounted as low as $735 during Black Friday and Christmas sales. After winter ended this model was kept out of most sales, but it’s coming back around now that the colder months are approaching with a combined $334 exclusive markdown to the best new price we have tracked.
You can browse the full (and changed-up) Bluetti Encore Sale lineup in our original coverage here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Exclusively save up to $310 on three Anker solar multi-camera security bundles with HomeBase 3 starting from $290 (Ends tonight)
We’ve secured three new exclusive Anker security deals from Wellbots, with one being the EufyCam S3 Pro 4K Solar Security 2-Cam Kit with HomeBase 3 down at $389.99 shipped , after using the code 9TO5EF160 at checkout. Out of stock at Amazon , we had a similar exclusive deal just before Prime Day for this bundle taking the cost down from $550 to $420. Now, though, for a short period that is only running through October 9, you can score an even larger $160 markdown for the second-lowest price we have tracked – just $10 above the low that last appeared during June’s Prime Day event. Head below to see all three of these exclusive bundles before they’re gone.
Exclusive Anker eufy security deals:
EufyCam 3 2-Cam Kit: $290 (Reg. $470) use code 9TO5EF180 at checkout
EufyCam 3 4K 4-Cam Kit: $390 (Reg. $700) use code 9TO5EF310 at checkout
EufyCam S3 Pro 2-Cam Kit: $390 (Reg. $550) use code 9TO5EF160 at checkout
This 43.5 MPH Superscooter is up to $900 off today, more Navee deals from $480 (Up to 65% off)
Navee currently has a ongoing Prime Day Deals Sale running through October 21 with up to 65% combined discounts, thanks to a bunch of select bonus extra savings codes. One surprising option in that camp is the premium UT5 Ultra X Electric SuperScooter down at $1,600 shipped , after using the code UT5U20 at checkout for an additional 20% savings, beating Amazon by $400 . Down from $2,500, this is a thrill-seeker’s delight that we’ve previously seen fall between $2,300 and $2,100 with most discounts, though there were some sale drops further to $2,000, $1,955, and most recently, $1,785 for Labor Day. During this latest sale event, you’re getting a larger $900 markdown that lands it at a new all-time low price. You can learn more about it in my hands-on review here .
You can check out the lineup of models getting bonus savings (with codes) here , or see the full lineup of deals (without codes) on the main sale page here .
Turn one outlet into two with Linkind’s new Matter Outdoor Smart Plug currently down at $23
EGO’s 16-inch carbon fiber cordless electric POWERLOAD string trimmer beats Prime Day down at $204 ($75 off)
Greenworks’ 24V 12-inch cordless chainsaw makes up to 85+ cuts for storm cleanup, firewood, more at $120 2026 low
Yozma’s IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike is back at an exclusive $1,699 low ($700 off) + IN 10 model at $999 ($600 off)
Govee’s permanent outdoor lights up to $160 off from $350, like the new 200-foot 2 Pro model at a new $640 low
Best new Green Deals landing this week
The savings this week are also continuing to a collection of other markdowns. To the same tune as the offers above, these all help you take a more energy-conscious approach to your routine. Winter means you can lock in even better off-season price cuts on electric tools for the lawn while saving on EVs and tons of other gear.
Anker’s Prime Deals Encore Sale offers 2,048Wh C2000 Gen 2 station + 400W panel at exclusive $1,330, more from $900
Segway’s extended Fall Deals Day Sale offers ZT3 Pro off-road e-scooter at $700 ($300 off), more from $150
Get 2x 1,024Wh DELTA 3 Classic power stations at $889 in latest EcoFlow flash sale ($309 off), more from $599
Bring home Segway’s i206 AWD and i215 LiDAR robot mowers at best prices to date from $849, more
